					14 heading Project 2 Regulatory Compliance — Current Internal Policies, Value: 1, ID: :r1c:
						15 text Project 2 Regulatory Compliance — Current Internal Policies
				16 container
					17 heading Internal AI-use policy, Value: 2, ID: :r3:
						18 text Internal AI-use policy
				19 container
					20 container :r4:
						21 text Policy version:  AI-POL-2026-08-15
				22 container
					23 heading Purpose, Value: 3, ID: :r5:
						24 text Purpose
				25 container
					26 text Quillhaven Academy uses AI only when the responsible owner can explain the use, preserve evidence, and route consequential decisions to an authorized human.
				27 container
					28 heading Learner and public transparency, Value: 3, ID: :r7:
						29 text Learner and public transparency
				30 container
					31 text •
					32 text A person directly interacting with an AI system must receive a clear notice before or at the first interaction unless the AI nature is obvious from the context.
				33 container
					34 text •
					35 text Public synthetic images, audio, or video must retain machine-readable provenance when the tool supports it. The Communications owner also requires a visible label unless Legal approves a documented exception.
				36 container
					37 text •
					38 text Staff-only drafting tools are not automatically treated as public interactions. The owner must still record how generated material reaches learners or the public.
				39 container
					40 heading Evidence and exceptions, Value: 3, ID: :rb:
						41 text Evidence and exceptions
				42 container
					43 text •
					44 text Each registered system must have a current owner, use description, exposed group, disclosure status, human-review path, and evidence reference.
				45 container
					46 text •
					47 container :rd:
						48 text missing ,  stale ,  conflicting , and  not-applicable  are different evidence states. Missing evidence must not be converted to compliance or non-compliance.
				49 container
					50 text •
					51 text An exception requires a named owner, rationale, expiry date, and Legal approval. The automation may draft an exception request but may not approve it.
				52 container
					53 heading Approval boundary, Value: 3, ID: :rf:
						54 text Approval boundary
				55 container
					56 text Legal owns final interpretation of the EU AI Act. Operations owns policy activation and operational deadlines. System owners correct evidence. The automation may prepare a draft impact package and proposed actions; it may not give final legal advice, activate policy, change a production deadline, close an incident, or submit an official response.
				57 container
					58 heading Article 50 review — company operating facts, Value: 2, ID: :rh:
						59 text Article 50 review — company operating facts
				60 container
					61 container :ri:
						62 text Context revision:  RC-CONTEXT-2026-09-12-R1
				63 container
					64 text Business observation date: 26 August 2026. Authoring clarification date: 12 September 2026. These case dates are separate from the date a learner retrieves the sources.
				65 container
					66 container :rk:
						67 text Prepared by Operations with the named system owners for the current review. These are authored facts for the fictional Quillhaven training case, not statements about a real company or a Legal decision. This context supplements the unchanged  AI-POL-2026-08-15  policy and the dated system, evidence and action registers. It does not revise their recorded notices, evidence states, proposed dates or approvals.
				68 container
					69 heading Operating scope, Value: 3, ID: :rl:
						70 text Operating scope
				71 container
					72 text This review concerns Quillhaven Academy's EU programme team operating from Dublin, Ireland. That team administers all eight registered uses for its professional work; the learners, applicants and staff concerned include people in Ireland, and the public campaign and programme outputs are used there. None of these uses is personal, military, national-security or law-enforcement activity. The systems are operating services, not research-only prototypes.
				73 container
					74 text For AI-001, AI-002, AI-003, AI-004, AI-006, AI-007 and AI-008, Quillhaven licenses and operates a third-party supplier's existing AI product. It did not develop or commission development of that product, distribute it as its own AI product, or place it into service under its own product name or trademark. The register's system names are internal inventory labels. Company content, ordinary settings and website placement do not describe a separately developed Quillhaven AI product. The current AI-005 release's development, commissioning and product-branding records are still awaiting the Assessment Operations owner refresh; the old questionnaire does not resolve them.
				75 container
					76 heading Actual use and content, Value: 3, ID: :ro:
						77 text Actual use and content
				78 container
					79 heading AI-001, Value: 4, ID: :rp:
						80 text AI-001
				81 container
					82 text Learners exchange questions and generated replies directly with the licensed support chat. It does not classify biometric data or infer emotions or intentions. The existing notice and evidence reports remain the source for disclosure practice.
				83 container
					84 heading AI-002, Value: 4, ID: :rr:
						85 text AI-002
				86 container
					87 text Staff use the drafting product privately. An admissions advisor reviews and edits a draft before personally sending an individual applicant email; applicants do not converse with the AI product. These are individual administrative replies, not material published to inform the public about matters of public interest.
				88 container
					89 heading AI-003, Value: 4, ID: :rt:
						90 text AI-003
				91 container
					92 text The current campaign uses visibly illustrated fictional classroom scenes. They are not depictions of an existing person, campus, object or event presented as an authentic photograph or recording. The supplier's product generates images from prompts; this use is not limited to minor correction of supplied images. The published-copy metadata conflict in REC-003 remains unresolved.
				93 container
					94 heading AI-004, Value: 4, ID: :rv:
						95 text AI-004
				96 container
					97 text Learners interact directly with the licensed spoken-practice product and receive pronunciation feedback. It evaluates spoken pronunciation; it is not used to identify or infer emotions or intentions or to assign people to categories from biometric data. The missing first-interaction notice remains as reported.
				98 container
					99 heading AI-005, Value: 4, ID: :r11:
						100 text AI-005
				101 container
					102 text The product flags assessment-session activity for a human reviewer and never makes the final assessment decision. Current-release documentation has not yet established whether the flagging uses biometric data to infer emotions, intentions or personal categories. Assessment Operations must supply those facts together with the current development and release records; a human-review step does not settle them.
				103 container
					104 heading AI-006, Value: 4, ID: :r13:
						105 text AI-006
				106 container
					107 text Staff generate internal meeting summaries within the restricted staff workspace. The summaries are not published or sent to applicants, learners or the general public. They do not involve generated or manipulated images, audio or video.
				108 container
					109 heading AI-007, Value: 4, ID: :r15:
						110 text AI-007
				111 container
					112 text Visitors converse directly with the licensed website guide. Its visible character is an obviously stylized fictional graphic, not a likeness or recording of an existing person. The graphic alone does not establish what visitors understand about the conversation. The owner/banner and current-capture conflict in REC-008 remains unresolved.
				113 container
					114 heading AI-008, Value: 4, ID: :r17:
						115 text AI-008
				116 container
					117 text Communications uses the supplier's product to create translated speech and adjusted lip movements for recorded programme presenters. The presenters are real people; the altered recording makes them appear to speak words in a language they did not actually record, and a viewer could mistake it for an authentic recording without disclosure. The videos communicate programme information, not an evidently artistic, satirical or fictional performance. The visible-label report, untested provenance and unapproved exception request remain exactly as recorded.
				118 container
					119 heading Product timing and evidence limits, Value: 3, ID: :r19:
						120 text Product timing and evidence limits
				121 container
					122 text The suppliers' product-release notices held by Operations report that the currently licensed image-generation product used for AI-003 and audio/video-generation product used for AI-008 were first offered commercially in the EU on 1 June 2026. These are product market-entry dates, not the dates Quillhaven exported or published individual images or videos. They do not identify Quillhaven as the supplier. Current release and market-entry evidence for AI-005 remains unavailable.
				123 container
					124 text This document records owner-supplied operating facts. It does not replace missing screenshots, prove provenance metadata survived publication, refresh stale evidence, authorize an exception or settle statutory applicability. No Legal approval, expiry date, activated policy or new operational deadline is supplied. Legal reviews the learner's supported interpretation; system owners resolve the specifically identified factual gaps.
